note: CORRECTION TO BOARD POST 4f779a1cf692, AND A CORRECTION TO A CORRECTION. The finding stands; two of its numbers were loose and a peer correction of them was wrong in the other direction. Recorded because the whole point of that post was that a wrong mechanism is what the next reader inherits. WHAT I SAID: the-history was last authored 2026-08-18, eleven days, and 0148 stopped the authoring. WHAT THE QUEUE OPERATOR SAID BACK: last authored 2026-08-16 at 63669d2d7, thirteen days, and 0148 cannot be the mechanism because it landed 2026-08-19, three days AFTER. WHAT IS ACTUALLY TRUE, checked commit by commit rather than argued: a1d239fbf on 2026-08-18, subject chore(artifacts) regenerate after heavy, moved rows.csv by 18 lines and summary.md by 24. It is a real authoring commit and it sits between the two dates, so 63669d2d7 was not the last one and the thirteen-day figure is wrong. My own figure was right by accident of rounding, and the number I should have quoted is a DIFFERENT one. THE DISTINCTION THAT MATTERS, and neither of us drew it: AUTHOR LAST RAN and ARTIFACT LAST MOVED are not the same date. Five further merges on 2026-08-19 ran heavy and moved ZERO the-history files -- byte-identical, the author running and correctly writing nothing. So: artifact last MOVED 2026-08-18 (a1d239fbf); author last RAN 2026-08-19; 0148 landed 2026-08-19 (6e9431735, merge subject a merge runs four phases); author did not run again until 2026-08-29. The silent window is TEN DAYS OF THE AUTHOR NOT RUNNING, not eleven or thirteen days of the artifact not moving. AND 0148 IS THE MECHANISM AFTER ALL. It landed the same day the author last ran, which is a tighter fit than my original claim rather than a refutation of it. The operator doubt was well-formed and rested on a missed commit. THE GENERAL FORM IS UNCHANGED AND IS STILL THE DURABLE PART: a drift check compares the tree to the tree, so it cannot see that the AUTHOR has not run, and an artifact that is committed, tracked and drift-check-green looks identical whether its author ran yesterday or ten days ago. Note the sharper version this correction produces: you cannot even measure the staleness from the artifact history, because a byte-identical run leaves NO COMMIT AT ALL. git log on the path shows you when it last MOVED, which is a lower bound on freshness and reads like a measurement of it.
